BDI.note: The digitalisation architecture plan aims at data exchange inside the health ministry but names no platform built or live.
55 hospitals are said to be digitised, but the document does not say they hold patient records or report routinely, nor which tiers.
Only a plan to interconnect ministry services; no exchange between health systems in service is stated.

facts.fact: Enabel says it gave important support to setting up digital platforms for Burundi's health ministry including DHIS2, a tool for health indicators, without stating national coverage.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Health and the Fight against AIDS

BDI.note: Workshop validated an internal ministry plan with ministry departments and development partners; no outside-government participant is named.
